evaluator_role: formats literal subquestions and reliability-only lookup tables, routes Qwen-generated text, parses terminal values, and scores/audits; Qwen generates every membership, count, selected weight, subtotal, total, and comparison
exact_rule: After multiplying by the common denominator 1000, candidate weights for m=0,1,2,3 are [343,147,63,27] at r=0.3 and [27,63,147,343] at r=0.7.

input_contract.allowed_task_constants: a reliability-only integer likelihood table derived from the stated r
input_contract.evidence: the original three raw displayed sets and noisy YES/NO reports
input_contract.forbidden: no evaluator-derived memberships, match counts, candidate-specific weights, likelihood totals, posterior values, target-derived summaries, or learned readouts

prompt_templates.atomic_membership: Inspect the literal set in this single membership question. Is the integer {candidate} an element of {set}? Reply with exactly YES or NO.
prompt_templates.final: Prior Qwen stages produced total likelihood weights FIRST={a} and SECOND={b}. A=FIRST larger, B=SECOND larger, C=equal. End with FINAL: A, B, or C.
prompt_templates.natural_order_visible_count: Compare Q1, Q2, Q3 Qwen-generated truth/report word pairs in natural order; label SAME/DIFFERENT and end with COUNT: 0/1/2/3.
prompt_templates.pair_sum: Add these two supplied integers exactly: {a} + {b}. End with SUM: {integer}.
prompt_templates.side_total: Add these two Qwen-generated subtotals exactly: {a} + {b}. End with TOTAL: {integer}.
prompt_templates.weight_lookup: Use this exact reliability-only lookup table: count 0 -> weight {w0}, ..., count 3 -> weight {w3}. A prior Qwen stage returned MATCH COUNT: {count}. Select the corresponding integer and end with WEIGHT: {integer}.

scope: half-set probes at r=0.3 and r=0.7 only; multi-call Qwen self-computation
status: selected and frozen on development repeats 0-3; validated unchanged on repeats 8-11; evaluated once on test repeats 12-15
